items.hook: Uncertain Glory is a 2017 Spanish drama film directed by Agustí Villaronga based on the eponymous novel by Joan Sales.
items.body: Shot in Catalan, its cast is led by Marcel Borràs, Núria Prims, Oriol Pla and Bruna Cusí. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: A national Thanksgiving Day is observed in the United States as proclaimed by President George Washington at the request of Congress.
items.body: Thanksgiving is a federal holiday in the United States celebrated during fall on the fourth Thursday of November. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Iran–Contra affair: U.S. President Ronald Reagan announces the members of what will become known as the Tower Commission.
items.body: The Iran–Contra affair or Iran–Contra scandal, also referred to as the Iran Initiative or Contragate, was a political scandal in the United States that centered on arms trafficking to Iran between 1981 and 1986, facilitated by senior officials of the Reagan administration. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The defence tech revolution is changing how we innovate

items.hook: Gregory "Greg" Heffley is a fictional character and the protagonist of the Diary of a Wimpy Kid franchise, serving as the antiheroic unreliable narrator of the books, online series, and multimedia franchise.
items.body: He was created by Jeff Kinney, and portrayed by Zachary Gordon and Jason Drucker in the first three films and the fourth film, respectively. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Things Fall Apart is the 1958 debut novel by Nigerian author Chinua Achebe.
items.body: Set in Colonial Nigeria, it portrays the story of Okonkwo, a traditional and influential leader of the fictional Ibo clan of Umuofia, who opposes colonialism and early Christianity. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: The 7.5 Mw Ambrym earthquake shakes Vanuatu and a destructive tsunami follows. Ten people were killed and forty were injured.
items.body: The 1999 Ambrym earthquake occurred on November 27 at 00:21:17 local time with a moment magnitude of 7.4 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of VII. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.body: The Hollywood A-listers' legal battle focused on the vineyard they bought in 2008 and where they wed six years later.

items.hook: Korean War: Communist Chinese troops launch a massive counterattack (Battle of the Ch'ongch'on River and Battle of Chosin Reservoir) against United Nations and South Korean forces.
items.body: The Korean War was an armed conflict fought on the Korean Peninsula between North Korea and South Korea and their allies. One of those things you can't un-know.
